changes_exactly: Service queued repair at gfx_run_dl entry instead of every decoded command.
Service during ordinary raw LOAD wait on the first busy observation and every16 busy polls thereafter.
liveness_reasoning: Worker drops shared FMA ownership before REPAIR, so delayed repair service cannot block arithmetic completion of the raw LOAD whose polling is throttled.
Raw timeout-drain/startup/busy-recovery loops still service each iteration.
Ring-space/DMA-descriptor/fence/translucency waits retain OF_GPU_WAIT_HOOK. Queue acquire, next display-list entry and frame end retain their explicit service points.
Independent fast-memory uploader polling does not depend on worker repair completion; it may defer repair service but cannot form that circular dependency.
Queue/snapshot pressure can force canonical fallback; ordered GPU stream and immutable repair operands are unchanged.
bounds: During ordinary long raw waits, repair is checked at most16 busy polls apart. Moving DL polling to entry does not establish a hard wall-time repair latency bound between other service points.
limits: This is a static liveness review, not a performance or sustained-hardware claim.
No repeated arithmetic/lazy tests needed because their actual function bodies and backend/SDK remain identical; final same-ELF replay remains required.
